name: bowire-vscode
description: The Bowire multi-protocol API workbench, hosted in VS Code. gRPC, REST, GraphQL, SignalR, MQTT, WebSocket, SSE, MCP and more — driving the same bowire CLI your terminal and CI already run.

bowire.cliPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `bowire` executable. Leave empty to search `PATH`. Supports `${workspaceFolder}`, so a project-local build can be committed to `.vscode/settings.json` and shared with the team.

enumDescriptions: Ask before downloading a CLI when none is installed.
Never download; show the install instructions instead.
bowire.autoDownload.markdownDescription: What to do when no Bowire is found through `#bowire.cliPath#`, a tool manifest or `PATH`. A downloaded CLI is pinned to the version this extension was tested with, lands in the extension's own storage, and is never preferred over an installed Bowire.
